Relevance Assessment in this corpus refers to the evaluation of clinical quality indicators and their applicability to specific patient populations. The available evidence for this topic is thin, consisting of a single assessment regarding [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]. According to the documentation, [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] (RHN) evaluated this specific indicator and immediately concluded that it is most relevant for a distinct group referred to as "4X patients" [^src1]. No further details, broader chronological context, or additional institutional assessments are available in the current data.

## Claims

- RHN tænker umiddelbart, at denne indikator er mest relevant for 4X patienter [^src1] (regionshospital-nordjylland, indikator-3)

  - Page: 106
